items.stem: A security manager wants the information-security strategy to directly support enterprise objectives. Which action best demonstrates governance alignment?

options.text: Mapping security initiatives to documented business goals and risk appetite approved by leadership
options.rationale: Correct: governance alignment ties security initiatives to business goals and an approved risk appetite.

options.text: Deploying the newest security tools regardless of business context
options.rationale: Tool-first decisions without business alignment are the opposite of governance alignment.

options.text: Delegating all strategy decisions to the firewall administrator
options.rationale: Strategy is a governance responsibility, not a single operator's task.

options.text: Avoiding any documentation to stay flexible
options.rationale: Governance depends on documented, approved direction.

items.explanation: Correct: governance alignment ties security initiatives to business goals and an approved risk appetite.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: In risk management, 'risk appetite' is best defined as which of the following?

options.text: The amount and type of risk an organization is willing to accept in pursuit of its objectives
options.rationale: Correct: risk appetite is the level of risk leadership is willing to accept to meet objectives.

options.text: The total number of vulnerabilities found in a scan
options.rationale: That is a technical finding count, not risk appetite.

options.text: The budget spent on security tools
options.rationale: Spend is an input, not a statement of acceptable risk.

options.text: The time taken to patch a system
options.rationale: Patch time is an operational metric, not risk appetite.

items.explanation: Correct: risk appetite is the level of risk leadership is willing to accept to meet objectives.

items.stem: Select TWO activities that belong to incident-response preparation. (Select TWO.)

options.text: Defining incident roles and an escalation path in advance
options.rationale: Correct: defining roles and escalation is preparation done before incidents occur.

options.text: Establishing and testing an incident-response plan
options.rationale: Correct: building and exercising the plan is preparation.
Sales forecasting is unrelated to incident response.
This is irrelevant to incident-response preparation.
